messages.content: Tell me about your experience with SIEM tools.
I operated Splunk daily for 3 years, tuning correlation rules and triaging alerts across 200 endpoints.
How do you approach incident response?
I follow a documented playbook: contain, eradicate, recover, then post-incident review with root cause analysis.
Describe a challenging security project.
I automated phishing triage with Python, reducing analyst workload by 40% while maintaining detection quality.
Introduce yourself briefly.
[silence]
Can you share one technical skill relevant to cybersecurity?
um
Why are you interested in this role?
I want to grow in security operations and contribute to proactive threat detection.
What is your experience with Linux hardening?
I configured SSH keys, disabled root login, and applied CIS benchmarks on Ubuntu servers in my last internship.
How do you stay updated on security threats?
I follow CERT advisories, read threat intel blogs, and practice on HackTheBox weekly.
Give an example of teamwork under pressure.
During a ransomware scare our team split containment and communications; I documented IOCs while others isolated hosts.
Any certifications?
I hold Security+ and I am preparing for CEH.
